role: structured quantitative extraction of published transcriptomic and biochemical evidence; not a raw-RNA reanalysis and not an independent experiment

source.citation: Casimiro-Soriguer et al. 2016, Frontiers in Plant Science 7:204
source.study_scope: Silene littorea, one polymorphic population; dark-pink, light-pink and white petals across bud/opening/anthesis stages
source.molecular_design: mRNA-seq of nine morph-by-stage samples; 29 anthocyanin-biosynthetic-pathway-related loci
source.extraction_rule: record all source-reported p<0.05 bud-stage pairwise expression contrasts involving white petals, plus significant dark-vs-light regulatory contrasts; record source-reported sequence and HPLC evidence relevant to the inferred F3h blockage

claim_ceiling: The published Silene littorea experiment provides quantitative transcriptomic and biochemical evidence consistent with a petal-specific regulatory blockage near F3h1/Myb1a. It anchors the PAL persistence contrast mechanistically but does not establish the molecular basis of the cross-species FCP white axis.
hard_nonclaims: does not prove Myb1a is the causal mutation
does not establish F3h1/Myb1a as a universal mechanism of white flowers or H2
